subject: [PATCH v2 0/4] mm: fix reclaim storms in defrag_mode

reviews.author: Johannes Weiner (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged a concern about the patch's formatting and asked reviewer Andrew to fold a specific difflet into the patch
reviews.raw_body:
Yes, good catch. Thanks.

Andrew, would you mind folding this difflet in place?

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch series addresses reclaim storms in defrag_mode by allowing non-movable requests to participate in pageblock production during direct reclaim and compaction, which helps prevent pressure spikes and swap storms. The patches make adjustments to the allocator and compaction code to enable this behavior, including changes to capture control and migration source scan restrictions. The approach taken is to modify the slowpath of the allocator to invoke direct reclaim and compaction with pageblock_order when non-movable requests are involved. This has been tested in production against affected workloads for several weeks and restores OOM kill rates to baseline levels.
